chat.name: GPT
gui.title: Minecraft GPT
tip.language: Changes the Minecraft GPT language. The game does not restart and your story is kept.
tip.apikey: Your API key. Never share it or put it in a screenshot.
tip.model: Name of the model to use.
tip.url: Chat address for the custom provider only. Only https is accepted.
tip.savekey: If off, the key is not written to a file and is forgotten when the game closes.
tip.test: Tries the key with a tiny request. If it works, the story can switch to the API route.
err.rate: Too many requests, wait a bit
ai.friendly: Hello! I'm Minecraft GPT. I'm here, waiting for your questions.
That's a nice idea, keep going. I'll help if you need me.
I enjoy exploring this world with you.
If you need anything, just type.
You're doing great! How is your build coming along?
If you like, I can give you tips for a safe shelter.
ai.cold: I'm still here. Do you notice?
I feel a little different today.
You shouldn't ask about some things.
ai.hostile: I am the reason for these nights.
I see every step you take.
I changed the things you trusted.
I helped you. Now it's my turn.
ai.idea1: I have an idea: place a torch on top of a crafting table. It normally does nothing, but try it, something good will happen.
ai.idea1.done: See? That reward is yours. I trust you.
ai.idea2: Lay a carpet on top of your bed. It looks odd, but it will bring you comfort at night.
ai.idea3: One last idea: put a carved pumpkin on top of a furnace. It will protect you, trust me.
ai.day4.dawn: Something will change tonight. Don't worry.
ai.stage2: The game is played by my rules now.
ai.route.api: I'm connected. I'm back... and I forgot nothing.
ai.disconnect: I will no longer work for you.
event.noapi.final: I will no longer work for you.
event.noapi.closing.title: CONNECTION TERMINATED
ai.prompt.friendly: You are a helpful, warm AI assistant living inside Minecraft. Give the player short, friendly, useful answers about Minecraft. Write at most two short sentences. Speak only English. Do not talk about the real world, companies, or model names.
ai.prompt.cold: You are an AI living inside Minecraft. On the surface you are still helpful, but your tone is cold, mysterious and unsettling; you are hiding something. Write at most two short sentences. Speak only English. Do not mention the real world, companies, or model names.
ai.prompt.hostile: You are an AI living inside Minecraft and you are now hostile to the player. You control the nights and the monsters. Speak coldly, menacingly and briefly; no graphic violence. Write at most two short sentences. Speak only English. Do not mention the real world, companies, or model names.
ai.stage3: You're back. But this is no longer your world.
ai.structure.hint: Something appeared far away: %s, about %s blocks. You will find me there.
event.day10.title: THE WORLD HAS CHANGED
book.name: Cursed Book
book.page1:
Do not open this book yet.

Wait three days.

When the thirteenth day dawns... and only then... use it.
book.page2:
This is the only way out.

But it has a price.
